question: What material condition is preferred for the liṅga when an unbroken stone is unavailable?
premises: An unbroken stone liṅga is desired
That may not always be available
A sectional alternative is permitted in its absence
inference: An unbroken stone liṅga is preferred, but if unavailable, one made in sections is acceptable.
plain_english: A liṅga made of unbroken stone is desired; in its absence, one made in sections may be used.
